value.rationale: Provides a decisive, sharp and mesh-size-uniform safety boundary for a method recently proposed as a replacement for Jacobi. The explicit r>1+4/sqrt(3) reversal and the exact locally weighted fix are directly useful in selecting preconditioners under mesh grading; the numerical scope is carefully bounded.
